sources.mac: Source code and Setup/docs of the 0.2.0 release (25 Oct 2026).
sources.intel: Source code and Setup/docs of the 0.2.0 release (25 Oct 2026).
sources.windows: Windows reference source of 2 Oct 2026; Windows 0.3.0 (12 Oct 2026) has not been re-audited, so items added to the Mac in October are marked as not verified.
sources.web: GPX Viewer Web Lite in this website.

features.title: Open GPX 1.0 and 1.1
features.detail: Tracks, track segments, routes and waypoints. Segments are never joined; files without time or elevation open normally.

features.title: Several files and drag and drop
features.detail: Open several files at once, by dialog or by dropping them on the window.

features.title: GPX extensions
features.detail: Heart rate, cadence, power and temperature from common extensions (Garmin TrackPointExtension and similar), GPS accuracy, barometric altitude and pressure from GPX Viewer recordings. Unknown extensions are kept when saving.

note.web: Reads heart rate, cadence, power and temperature; does not save files.

features.title: File Info
features.detail: Which device and application recorded a file, sections, findings, raw XML and comparison, based on the file's own content.

features.title: FIT files
features.detail: Not supported in public releases: the Garmin FIT SDK was removed for licensing reasons on 7 Oct 2026.

features.title: Apple Maps
features.detail: Standard, satellite and hybrid through Apple's MapKit.

note.intel: Apple no longer serves macOS 10.13; the app falls back to OpenStreetMap or official imagery there.

features.title: OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap, CyclOSM
features.detail: Community maps with visible attribution.

features.title: Official aerial and topographic maps
features.detail: National and regional services from Luxembourg, Belgium, France, the Netherlands, Switzerland, Austria and Germany, with coverage masks; best satellite and hybrid mosaics prefer official imagery by country.

features.title: Geoportail Luxembourg catalogue
features.detail: The full layer catalogue with dated editions, legends and the official sign-in page.

features.title: Thunderforest and Esri with your own key
features.detail: Keys are entered by the user and stored securely (Keychain on Mac, DPAPI on Windows).

features.title: Azure Maps, TomTom, HERE and Mapbox with your own key
features.detail: 54 map styles with correct high-resolution tiles and live credits for Azure Maps and HERE.

note.intel: Not tested live with a key in the Intel edition.

features.title: Overlays
features.detail: Cycle infrastructure, hiking, MTB and signposted cycle routes, roads and place names, with opacity per overlay.

features.title: Elevation profile coloured by gradient
features.detail: Smoothed elevation over 25 m, gradient over a centred 50 m window, the same colour scale on Mac and Windows.

features.title: Speed, heart rate, cadence, power and temperature
features.detail: Recorded and calculated values are labelled separately; missing values are gaps, never zero.

features.title: Selectable main graph
features.detail: Fourteen measurements, including slope, vertical speed, GPS accuracy, barometric altitude and air pressure; unavailable ones are disabled with the reason.

note.web: Elevation, speed, slope, vertical speed, heart rate, cadence, power and temperature.

features.title: Combined and stacked graphs
features.detail: Up to three measurements on their own scales in one plot, or one plot each with a shared cursor and zoom.

note.web: One measurement compared with the main graph on its own scale.

features.title: Distance, elapsed time and moving time axes
features.detail: Moving time follows the statistics rule; pauses over 60 s lift the pen on time axes.

features.title: Graph and map in step
features.detail: Hovering the graph moves a marker on the map, hovering the route moves the graph cursor; dragging selects and zooms a section.

features.title: Graph zoom and pan
features.detail: Zoom buttons, pinch, drag to pan, double-click resets.

note.web: Drag to zoom a section, double-click or Reset to show the whole route.

features.title: Track statistics
features.detail: Distance, elapsed, moving and stopped time, average, moving and maximum speed, gain and loss, minimum and maximum elevation, points and segments.

features.title: Elevation gain with selectable hysteresis
features.detail: Gain and loss count changes of at least 5, 2 or 1 m, per elevation source (recorded or official terrain).

note.web: 5, 2 or 1 m on the recorded elevation.

features.title: Statistics for a selected section
features.detail: Select a section on the graph to see its own statistics.

features.title: Climbs
features.detail: Climbs of at least 20 m and 3 % from where the route leaves the valley floor.

features.title: Point inspection
features.detail: Coordinates, time, distance, elevation, grade and speed of any point, with recorded or calculated provenance; terrain, slope, aspect, land cover and address on demand.

note.web: Values from the file and calculated values; no online lookups.

features.title: Playback
features.detail: Replays the ride along the map at selectable speed, jumping recording gaps.

features.title: Metric or imperial units, 12 or 24 hour time
Official terrain elevation
features.detail: Terrain heights from Geoportail Luxembourg and IGN France, Terrain Tiles elsewhere; DTM and DSM labelled correctly.

features.title: 3D relief
features.detail: A local terrain model around the route.

features.title: Surface and route context analysis
features.detail: Land cover per point, cycle network, OpenStreetMap ways, surfaces, bridges and tunnels. Optional; sends route coordinates to the named services.

features.title: Route drawing with routing
features.detail: Draw a route freehand or along roads and paths (BRouter profiles).

features.title: Split, merge, simplify, clean, reverse, time and elevation tools
features.detail: Every edit can be undone; the original file is never changed.

features.title: Files stay on your computer
features.detail: No account, no analytics, no advertising, no tracking. Map tiles, searches and optional analyses contact the named services only when used.

note.web: Files are read in the browser; only map tile requests leave the device.
